summary.value: On Christmas Eve the strongest sorcerer alive and the King of Curses meet in Shinjuku, while elsewhere other sorcerers move to bring the Culling Game to an end. The fight, and what follows it, decides who the jujutsu world belongs to.

events.title: A month of preparation
events.detail: Chapter 222. Both sides get ready for the agreed date.

events.title: Hollow Purple across the city
events.detail: Gojo fires an amplified Hollow Purple across Tokyo at Sukuna before he arrives in Shinjuku.

events.title: The domains meet
events.detail: The two fighters expand their domains at the same time.

events.title: Takaba against Kenjaku
events.detail: Chapters 239 to 243 follow a comedian whose odd technique stalls a far more experienced opponent.
